s.zh: （1.62.0）新生成的人形有机会带 1～2 个 DND 性格特性：阵营（守序 / 混乱、仁善 / 邪恶，最多一个）、种族互动（惧龙、屠龙志士、巨人仆从、巨人杀手、巫妖信徒、不死猎人、世界公民、纯血至上、殖巢幸存者、龙之眷从、吉斯流亡者）、职业天赋（战术家、奥术天赋、狂野魔法、机械迷、自然之子）和怪癖（魔法恐惧、秘法上瘾、寻宝狂、位面错乱）。\n只用原版 3 个特性名额里的空位：有空位时 40% 带一个，再有空位时 15% 带第二个，默认约四分之一的人形至少带一个。塞伊多邪恶与守序、费伦拓荒同盟多仁善、余烬氏族多混乱、猎巫狂热分子多守序，狗头人多龙之眷从。\n关闭后不再生成，已有的保留；读档不会给老殖民者补发。
s.en: (1.62.0) Newly generated humanlikes have a chance to carry 1-2 DND personality traits: alignment (lawful / chaotic, good / evil, at most one), racial interactions (dragon dread, dragonslayer zealot, giant's servant, giantslayer, lich devotee, undead hunter, citizen of the world, pureblood supremacist, hive survivor, dragon's thrall, githyanki exile), class gifts (tactician, arcane gift, wild magic, tinkerer, child of nature) and quirks (magic phobia, arcana addict, treasure maniac, planar confusion).\nOnly uses free slots among the 3 vanilla trait slots: 40% for one when there's a free slot, 15% for a second if another is free; by default about a quarter of humanlikes have at least one. Thay has more evil and lawful, the Faerûn Frontier Alliance more good, the Ember Clan more chaotic, witch-hunting zealots more lawful, and kobolds more dragon's thralls.\nWhen off, no new ones generate; existing ones are kept; loading a save doesn't give them to old colonists.

s.zh: （1.62.0）红色强力特性：复仇亡魂、兽化症（狼 / 熊 / 虎）是史诗，远域之触是稀有。和其他强力特性一起算数量，在同一次随机里出现：普通种族 1.5%、中等 1%、传奇种族 0.5%（× 强力特性出现率）；剧情首领、宿敌冠军带强力特性时 15% 是红色（不会是复仇亡魂）。兽化症能通过咬伤传染，远域之触能被心灵震爆、逃离殖巢开局、耐瑟启迪染上。\n关闭后不再随机生成、也不会传染，已有的保留。
s.en: (1.62.0) Red power traits: vengeful revenant and lycanthropy (wolf / bear / tiger) are epic, touched by the Far Realm is rare. They count together with other power traits and appear in the same random roll: common races 1.5%, middle 1%, legendary races 0.5% (× power trait frequency); when story bosses and nemesis champions carry power traits, 15% are red (never vengeful revenant). Lycanthropy spreads through bites, and touched by the Far Realm can be caught from psychic blasts, the escaped-hive start and Netherese insight.\nWhen off, they no longer generate randomly or spread; existing ones are kept.
